references.text: Prescribes a tenth of an ephah of fine flour as a grain offering for each lamb, the same amount as in Numbers 28:21
The same chapter describes a tenth of an ephah of flour for each lamb as a grain offering with the daily sacrifice
Repeats the same regulation concerning a tenth of an ephah for each of the seven lambs at the New Moon festival
The same provision regarding a tenth of an ephah of flour per lamb at the feast in the seventh month
Prescribes a tenth of an ephah for each of the seven lambs on the Day of Atonement
Mentions seven lambs as a burnt offering together with a grain offering at the festival
Ezekiel describes a grain offering of one ephah of flour for each lamb at festivals and feasts
